name: Foam Roller Upper Back Roll
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with a foam roller placed horizontally across your mid-back, knees bent, and feet flat on the ground.
Cross your arms over your chest or cup your hands gently behind your head to expose the muscles between your shoulder blades.
Lift your hips slightly off the floor and roll slowly up and down between your mid-back and the top of your shoulder blades.
Continue rolling smoothly through your upper back for the target duration before lowering your hips to finish.
tips: Keep your core lightly braced and avoid rolling down onto your lower back or up onto your neck.
Pause briefly over stiff areas of the upper back and take a slow exhale to encourage thoracic mobility.
